introHtml: Multi color banners, mats, and signs give you the flexibility to incorporate your full brand palette, highlight multiple messages, or create eye-catching event signage. Whether you need a vibrant entrance mat with your logo or a safety sign with color-coded warnings, multi color printing ensures every detail stands out. Screen printing and digital printing both work well for multi color designs on vinyl banners, rubber mats, and aluminum signs. Choose this option when you want more than a single color to communicate your brand or information effectively.
